'''Suzu''' is a [[Legacy Talismans|Legacy Talisman]] from [[Ashinohara]], in the possession of the Miko of Flaming Sakura, [[Hiyuki]]. Like the other Talismans, it was left behind in the country for safekeeping by the [[Sentinels]].
